# References this tree quotes as they read on a day, rather than as claims about
# this commit. One entry per line: the document, a tab, and the reference text as
# the document carries it.
#
# An entry is a debt and not a dispensation. It is refused when the reference it
# names starts agreeing again, and refused when no document carries it at all, so
# it cannot outlive the repair it stands in for.
